svg.title: Pitwall features
svg.desc: Models load when they are needed: Released when idle or when memory runs short, never while answering. See every request: Which app asked, which model answered and how long it took. Know if it fits before you download: A fit check per quantisation, and downloads verified by SHA-256. Serve more at once: Choose parallel slots and see the memory each one adds.
svg.text: Run models on your own machine and share them with every app.
